items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 12 October 2026 5:29am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

S or SE 5 or 6, soon veering S or SW 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in the evening, then 6 or 7 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, soon becoming slight or moderate, then moderate or rough overnight.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain or drizzle, with areas of mist developing and the risk of fog patches. Rain arriving overnight, heavy at times.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor in rain/drizzle/mist. Occasionally very poor in any fog patches. Becoming good later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

15°C
